title: Chase County Nebraska deputy sees 30-50 drones and mothership

tellings.quote: Reports from Colorado indicate that drones were not flying as a group or pack, but as a single unit. Chase County, Nebraska sheriff deputy reported observing 30 to 50

plain: Over the winter of 2019 to 2020, a sheriff's deputy in Chase County, Nebraska, is said to have reported seeing 30 to 50 drones along with a large mothership, while reports from Colorado said the drones flew not as a pack but as a single unit. Marik von Rennenkampff, a guest on an episode debating UFO skepticism, reads these out from reports and names a man called Doug Johnson as a source. If true, it would mean large, coordinated groups of unknown craft flew over the American plains.
